review: Ch’unokkun Hong Lu is a promising Bleed and Poise ID that introduces the new status “Trussed”, which entails targeting a specific unit who has the Trussed status for more damage on them as well as debuff infliction. To begin with his kit, we will first start with Hong Lu’s unique effects and his two passives. - Trussed [Hong Lu]- will make the person inflicted with it have 2 less min and max speed and take +10% Pride damage. This effect would only decay on turn end when the inflictor did not hit the enemy with this status and when the inflictor leaves the battlefield or inflicts it onto another enemy. You can stack this effect up to 3 times.
